title: Confusing error when packing nodes with exported variables (Parameter "common_parent" is null)
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1], v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e]

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8183) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 15.34 GiB memory

### Issue description

When a node has an exported variable that is pointing to another node which has a different parent and then you pack the first node into a `PackedScene` it produces a confusing error:
```
E 0:00:00:985   main.gd:12 @ _ready(): Parameter "common_parent" is null.
  <C++ Source>  scene/main/node.cpp:2354 @ get_path_to()
  <Stack Trace> main.gd:12 @ _ready()
```
which doesn't give you any context of where the problem is and how to avoid it.

Also I'm not sure how to avoid this error from being spammed into the debugger pane and polluting the error list.

### Steps to reproduce

Make a scene like this
```
root
├── node_to_pack_1/
│   └── child_of_1 (has a ref to child_of_2)
└── node_to_pack_2/
    └── child_of_2 (has a ref to child_of_1)
```
and then write a script to pack every child of the root node.

Or run the MRP.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[packedscene_common_parent_is_null_2026-03-03_14-24-06.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25713817/packedscene_common_parent_is_null_2026-03-03_14-24-06.zip)
